description: This file defines classes and functions for processing test expectations and results JSON data related to web layout tests, including fetching, parsing, and analyzing flaky tests and unexpected results.

classes.name: ResultsJSON
classes.description: Handles parsing and walking through the results.json data structure, providing methods to access test results and expectations.

classes.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory
classes.description: Factory class to fetch and create BotTestExpectations objects based on builder names and port configurations.

classes.name: BotTestExpectations
classes.description: Analyzes test results JSON to identify flaky tests, unexpected results, and generate expectation lines for tests.

methods.name: ResultsJSON._walk_trie
methods.description: Recursively walks through the nested trie structure of test results.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.walk_results
methods.description: Yields full paths and corresponding result data for all tests.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.expectation_for_type
methods.description: Returns the expectation string for a given result type character.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.occurances_and_type_from_result_item
methods.description: Extracts run-length and type info from a result item.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory._results_json_for_port
methods.description: Fetches results JSON data for a specific port name.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory._results_json_for_builder
methods.description: Fetches results JSON data for a specific builder.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory.expectations_for_port
methods.description: Returns expectations object for a given port.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory.expectations_for_builder
methods.description: Returns expectations object for a given builder.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations._line_from_test_and_flaky_types
methods.description: Creates a test expectation line object from test path and flaky types.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.flakes_by_path
methods.description: Identifies tests with flaky results based on multiple distinct result types.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.unexpected_results_by_path
methods.description: Finds tests with unexpected results compared to expectations.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.all_results_by_path
methods.description: Returns all distinct result types observed for each test.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.expectation_lines
methods.description: Generates expectation lines for flaky tests.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations._all_types_in_results
methods.description: Extracts all result types from run-length encoded results.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations._result_to_enum
methods.description: Converts a result string to its enum representation.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations._flaky_types_in_results
methods.description: Determines flaky result types based on multiple retries and expectations.
